name: Career Forge — AI Resume & Job Match Studio
tagline: Instant ATS scoring, XYZ bullet rewrites, cover letters & interview prep.
description:
Career Forge combines deterministic ATS heuristics with Anna LLM writing assistance.

ATS Match, Keyword Radar, formatting checks and bullet audits run in the bundled Python engine. Scores are transparent heuristics, not predictions of hiring outcomes.

Click Generate inside the app for AI XYZ bullet rewrites, cover letters in three tones, recruiter outreach and five STAR interview questions. These features call anna.llm.complete with your resume, job description, role, company and selected tone. Drafts must be reviewed; unknown metrics should remain placeholders, and missing skills must not be claimed as experience. No chat buttons or chat handoff are included.

Privacy: scoring uses the bundled engine on the Anna Agent (including Cloud Agents), not necessarily your device. AI writing sends the supplied career data to Anna’s configured LLM; Anna’s model usage and privacy policies apply. Drafts and scan history persist in Anna Storage and Agent state. No separate API key is required.

Choose a preset or paste your resume and job description, run ATS Match Scan, then generate writing in the corresponding tabs.
